correctness.rationale: The graph C_n□K_3 has four distinct neighbours per vertex for n≥3. Fixed opinion condition is at least two of four agreeing neighbours (tie retains current opinion); the 64 pair-column transfer has exactly 182 legal transitions. A labelled closed walk gives one fixed assignment, so F_n=tr(T^n). The explicit characteristic polynomial factorization yields the four power sums and the unique leading eigenvalue 3, while the remaining roots have modulus <2. Independently reconstructed T and computed the exact 64×64 characteristic polynomial using SymPy; verified factorization and counts F_3..F_6=32,94,218,712. This is exact finite algebra plus a valid transfer-bijection proof, not finite enumeration claimed as infinite proof.
